Subject: Payment Confirmation

Good morning, Fernando,

I just want to confirm that you have received the checks and that you are
able to cash the funds. The funds have been available in the account since
yesterday, yet I see the transaction has not been completed and you
declined the email transfer.

Please note that I have records and proof of all payments issued to you.
Hopefully, there are no issues on your end or mine.

Kindly confirm that you received this message regarding your payment, as
the payment has indeed been issued.

Thank you very much, and I wish you a great day.

Best regards,
Matthieu Wallace Barnard

Subject: Payment Confirmation

Good morning, Fernando,

I just want to confirm that you have received the checks and that you are able to cash the funds. The funds have been available in the account since yesterday, yet I see the transaction has not been completed and you declined the email transfer.

Please note that I have records and proof of all payments issued to you. Hopefully, there are no issues on your end or mine.

Kindly confirm that you received this message regarding your payment, as the payment has indeed been issued.

Thank you very much, and I wish you a great day.

Best regards,
Matthieu Wallace Barnard
